root_cause.text: The IP-TFS reassembly function `iptfs_reassem_cont` calls `skb_put()` to append data to a socket buffer (`newskb`) that has become non-linear from a prior zero-copy fragment addition, triggering an `SKB_LINEAR_ASSERT` panic.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff adds a call to `skb_linearize(newskb)` in `net/xfrm/xfrm_iptfs.c` before calling `skb_put(newskb, copylen)` to ensure the socket buffer is linear before appending copied fragment data.
